description: This file defines types, constants, and function prototypes for the LIN (Local Interconnect Network) driver in an AUTOSAR-based automotive software platform. It includes version info, configuration structures, enums for response and checksum types, status codes, and API functions for LIN communication.

methods.name: Lin_Init
methods.description: Initializes the LIN driver with configuration data.

methods.name: Lin_WakeupValidation
methods.description: Validates wake-up signal on LIN bus.

methods.name: Lin_InitChannel
methods.description: Initializes a specific LIN channel with configuration.

methods.name: Lin_SendHeader
methods.description: Sends a LIN header on a specified channel.

methods.name: Lin_SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response on a specified LIN channel.

methods.name: Lin_GoToSleep
methods.description: Puts LIN channel into sleep mode.

methods.name: Lin_GoToSleepInternal
methods.description: Puts LIN channel into internal sleep mode.

methods.name: Lin_WakeUp
methods.description: Wakes up LIN channel from sleep.

methods.name: Lin_GetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current status of LIN channel.

methods.name: Lin_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Provides version information of LIN driver.
